author: PI5TON
body:
To start of my user name is JD_AtTheTop, I was banned March 8th 2015 for using forcefield, and auto criticals. At first I was confused to why I was banned, as I have never used a modded clinic in my life time, but after a few weeks I found out why. My younger brother who uses my computer time to time, downloaded and used a modded clinic on multiple servers. He managed to get me banned from four servers in the time that I left him alone with my computer.I have been waiting close to two months before appealing for an infraction as I know it is necessary for getting a positive response. I sincerely apologize for what has happened and assure you that it won't happen again. 
         
          Thank you for your understanding,
                                 
                            Sincerely,  Jordan Duncan

This appeal is Denied.

Reason: Your account, Your responsibility. Doesn't matter who hacked on the account. The fact is that this account was using hacks on our server and so it is banned.
